test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that gives the most appropriate meaning of the underlined word.

The women of this country never questioned anything. Why are they so __credulous__?

options.text: Indifferent to the basic necessities of life
Reluctant to face the difficulties of life with courage
Willing to believe promptly without adequate evidence

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.
